title: Eight-sided polynomial tag decoding with 4 entries per list and prefix syndrome scoring with cumulative leader pair caps and column-prefix pair caps and both individual distance cutoffs

claims.statement: The fixed product of five [400,200] components with length-eight polynomial tags and 4 relative-list entries per side has average block error at most 984221321874997901/1000000000000000000 on the 2000-use BSC(1/10) for uniform 1000-bit data, when decoded by the counted program in proof.md.
The same bsc-ops-v1 program executes exactly W=1846672 primitives for every received word and W<=2^(41633/2000).

experiments.purpose: Check exact local spectra and one cumulative pair profile under both sum and individual distance cutoffs. The last sector also verifies the two exact score claims and finite decoder count.
